review.provenance: Independent local mechanical replay by the parent reviewer and a separate review agent; not human answer-quality review.
review.comparison: The whole replayed JSON document equals the saved result after deleting only results[*].candidate.proposal.resources from both documents. No other field is removed, rounded or rewritten.

scope: The fixed exposed-development preparer accepts only this exact repository path and raw result SHA-256. Changed result bytes require a new independently reviewed record and code change; editing metadata or recomputing input hashes does not authorize different candidate sources.
limitations: All twelve products were already exposed development data.
Replay verifies deterministic selection from previously saved local scores; it does not authenticate provider origin or recompute model logits.
Runtime resource observations differ between replays and are excluded from structural equality; the exact original observations remain protected by the raw result SHA-256.
Literal source-fact delivery does not establish semantic applicability, answer correctness or answer-quality improvement.
